answer: Answers are salted with a 254 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. Because the garden salt is published after the dune checkpoint, the nectar audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 61 keys therefore forfeits for 61 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
